children: Grayscale Chainlink Trust ETF entered into a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement to add Anchorage Digital as an additional custodian for a portion of the Trust's LINK holdings. Coinbase remains the primary custodian, and the Sponsor will allocate assets between custodians at its discretion. Anchorage Digital will safeguard private keys in U.S.-based hardware security modules, and maintain insurance the Sponsor believes is industry standard. The move reflects the Trust's risk management approach as it scales.
: Custody services agreement (Sixth Amendment to Master Custody Service Agreement)
: Diversify custody and enhance risk management as assets grow
